note: The cmux custom icon family, drawn in the agent chat's recipe: 1.5 line, round caps and joins, 3-unit corners, Line at rest and a filled Solid with the details cut out. The folder is Untitled UI's folder (free set), scaled to the live area. Debug Settings icons.family = custom lays these over design/icons/source; scripts/icons/build_pack.py builds the overlay.
